'''Cell block 2018''' was a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] cell block in the [[Ultraviolent Offenders Containment]] section of the [[Maximum Security Section]], a sector of the [[Belsavis prison]] facility on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. The [[Gen'Dai/Legends|Gen'Dai]] [[Agrular]] the Mad was one of the prisoners incarcerated in block 2018, and during the [[invasion of Belsavis]] in the [[Galactic War]], [[Buzz (Geonosian)|Buzz]] and [[Squarg]], two subordinates of the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Ivory]], freed Agrular but the three were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a [[Voidhound|smuggler]] before they could escape the cell block.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cell block 2018 is a class-restricted area on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where the Smuggler class mission "Aggravated Assault" occurs.<ref name="TOR" />
